questions.prompt: Cutoff opens, button holds AK. The 3-bet is…

choices.text: A pure bluff with no showdown value

questions.explanation: AK is ahead of a cutoff open and of many calls. That is a value 3-bet.

questions.prompt: You are in the small blind and 3-bet to the same chips you would use on the button. The usual fix is…

choices.text: 3-bet larger out of position, about 4× the open rather than 3×

questions.explanation: Out of position you want more folds and a bigger pot when called, so the 3-bet is larger.

questions.prompt: A value 3-bet and a bluff 3-bet differ because…

choices.text: Bluffs always go all-in and value always limps
Value hands fold to an open
Value continues against a 4-bet more often; bluffs with blockers usually fold

questions.explanation: QQ continues versus many 4-bets. A5s usually does not.

questions.prompt: Against a very loose button opener, a sound adjustment is…

choices.text: Widen value 3-bets. Their open contains more dominated hands.

questions.explanation: Looser opens are attacked with a wider value range, not a tighter one.
